source.title: Exposition on Psalm 23
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 23

paragraphs.text: 1. The Church speaks to Christ: <quote>The Lord feeds me, and I shall lack nothing</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:1}} . The Lord Jesus Christ is my Shepherd, <quote>and I shall lack nothing.</quote>

2. <quote>In a place of pasture there has He placed me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:2}} . In a place of fresh pasture, leading me to faith, there has He placed me to be nourished. <quote>By the water of refreshing has He brought me up.</quote> By the water of baptism, whereby they are refreshed who have lost health and strength, has He brought me up.

3. <quote>He has converted my soul: He has led me forth in the paths of righteousness, for His Name's sake</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:3}} . He has brought me forth in the narrow ways, wherein few walk, of His righteousness; not for my merit's sake, but for His Name's sake.

4. <quote>Yea, though I walk in the midst of the shadow of death</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:4}} . Yea, though I walk in the midst of this life, which is the shadow of death. <quote>I will fear no evil, for You are with me.</quote> I will fear no evil, for You dwell in my heart by faith: and You are now with me, that after the shadow of death I too may be with You. <quote>Your rod and Your staff, they have comforted me.</quote> Your discipline, like a rod for a flock of sheep, and like a staff for children of some size, and growing out of the natural into spiritual life, they have not been grievous to me; rather have they comforted me: because You are mindful of me.

5. <quote>You have prepared a table in my sight, against them that trouble me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:5}} . Now after the rod, whereby, while a little one, and living the natural life, I was brought up among the flock in the pastures; after that rod, I say, when I began to be under the staff, You have prepared a table in my sight, that I should no more be fed as a babe with milk, {{BIBLE:1co 3:2}} but being older should take meat, strengthened against them that trouble me. <quote>You have fattened my head with oil.</quote> You have gladdened my mind with spiritual joy. <quote>And Your inebriating cup, how excellent is it!</quote> And Your cup yielding forgetfulness of former vain delights, how excellent is it!

6. <quote>And Your mercy shall follow me all the days of my life:</quote> that is, as long as I live in this mortal life, not Yours, but mine. <quote>That I may dwell in the house of the Lord for length of days</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 22:6}} . Now Your mercy shall follow me not here only, but also that I may dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

latex.p0003: 1. 教会向基督说：\Quote{主牧养我，我必一无所缺} \BibleRef{咏 22:1}。主耶稣基督是我的牧者，\Quote{我必一无所缺。}
latex.p0004: 2. \Quote{在青草地上祂使我躺卧} \BibleRef{咏 22:2}。在鲜嫩牧草之地，引我进入信德，祂安置我在那里受滋养。\Quote{祂领我到静谧的水旁。}借着圣洗之水，那些失去健康与力量的人得以复苏，祂领我上来。
latex.p0005: 3. \Quote{祂使我的灵魂苏醒，为了祂的名，引导我走上正义的途径} \BibleRef{咏 22:3}。祂领我走上祂正义的窄路，其中行走的人甚少；并非因我的功德，而是为了祂的名。
latex.p0006: 4. \Quote{纵使我走过死亡的幽谷} \BibleRef{咏 22:4}。纵使我走过此生，它不过是死亡的幽影。\Quote{我不怕凶险，因为祢与我同在。}我不怕凶险，因为祢借着信德居住在我心中；祢如今与我同在，使我经过死亡的幽影后，也能与祢同在。\Quote{祢的牧杖和棍杖，它们安慰了我。}祢的管教，如同羊群的牧杖，又如同渐长的孩童的棍杖，从属自然生命成长到属灵生命，它们对我不曾是重担；反而安慰了我，因为祢顾念我。
latex.p0007: 5. \Quote{在我敌人面前，祢为我摆设筵席} \BibleRef{咏 22:5}。自牧杖之后——当我仍是幼小者，过着属自然的生活，在牧场上被牧养于羊群中——我且说，自牧杖之后，当我开始处于棍杖之下时，祢在我面前摆设筵席，使我不要再如婴孩般吃奶，\BibleRef{格前 3:2}而是年长后吃干粮，得以坚强，对抗那困扰我的人。\Quote{祢用油膏了我的头。}祢以属灵的喜乐使我心神欢畅。\Quote{祢的杯爵何等甘美，令人陶醉！}祢的杯爵使人忘却从前虚妄的欢乐，何其卓越！
latex.p0008: 6. \Quote{祢的慈爱必追随我终生：}即在我活于此可朽生命的全部时日，并非祢的生命，而是我的。\Quote{使我得以长久住在主的殿宇中} \BibleRef{咏 22:6}。如今祢的慈爱不仅在此追随我，且使我永远住在主的殿宇中。
